verses.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verses.pt: Portanto, és inescusável, ó homem, qualquer que sejas, quando julgas, porque te condenas a ti mesmo naquilo em que julgas a outro; pois tu que julgas, praticas o mesmo.
verses.en_web: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
verses.en_bbe: So you have no reason, whoever you are, for judging: for in judging another you are judging yourself, for you do the same things.

verses.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
verses.pt: E bem sabemos que o juízo de Deus é segundo a verdade, contra os que tais coisas praticam.
verses.en_web: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
verses.en_bbe: And we are conscious that God is a true judge against those who do such things.

verses.en: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.pt: E tu, ó homem, que julgas os que praticam tais coisas, cuidas que, fazendo-as tu, escaparás ao juízo de Deus?
verses.en_web: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.en_bbe: But you who are judging another for doing what you do yourself, are you hoping that God's decision will not take effect against you?

verses.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.pt: Ou desprezas tu as riquezas da sua benignidade, e paciência e longanimidade, ignorando que a benignidade de Deus te conduz ao arrependimento?
verses.en_web: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
verses.en_bbe: Or is it nothing to you that God had pity on you, waiting and putting up with you for so long, not seeing that in his pity God's desire is to give you a change of heart?

verses.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.pt: Mas, segundo a tua dureza e teu coração impenitente, entesouras ira para ti no dia da ira e da revelação do justo juízo de Deus,
verses.en_web: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.en_bbe: But by your hard and unchanged heart you are storing up wrath for yourself in the day of the revelation of God's judging in righteousness;

verses.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
verses.pt: que retribuirá a cada um segundo as suas obras;
verses.en_web: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
verses.en_bbe: Who will give to every man his right reward:

verses.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
verses.pt: a saber: a vida eterna aos que, com perseverança em favor o bem, procuram glória, e honra e incorrupção;
verses.en_web: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
verses.en_bbe: To those who go on with good works in the hope of glory and honour and salvation from death, he will give eternal life:

verses.en: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
verses.pt: mas ira e indignação aos que são contenciosos, e desobedientes à iniqüidade;
verses.en_web: but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,
verses.en_bbe: But to those who, from a love of competition, are not guided by what is true, will come the heat of his wrath,

verses.en: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
verses.pt: tribulação e angústia sobre a alma de todo homem que pratica o mal, primeiramente do judeu, e também do grego;
verses.en_web: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.en_bbe: Trouble and sorrow on all whose works are evil, to the Jew first and then to the Greek;

verses.en: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
verses.pt: glória, porém, e honra e paz a todo aquele que pratica o bem, primeiramente ao judeu, e também ao grego;
verses.en_web: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.en_bbe: But glory and honour and peace to all whose works are good, to the Jew first and then to the Greek:

verses.en: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.pt: pois para com Deus não há acepção de pessoas.
verses.en_web: For there is no partiality with God.
verses.en_bbe: For one man is not different from another before God.

verses.en: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.pt: Porque todos os que sem lei pecaram, sem lei também perecerão; e todos os que sob a lei pecaram, pela lei serão julgados.
verses.en_web: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
verses.en_bbe: All those who have done wrong without the law will get destruction without the law: and those who have done wrong under the law will have their punishment by the law;

verses.en: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
verses.pt: Pois não são justos diante de Deus os que só ouvem a lei; mas serão justificados os que praticam a lei
verses.en_web: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
verses.en_bbe: For it is not the hearers of the law who will be judged as having righteousness before God, but only the doers:

verses.en: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
verses.pt: (porque, quando os gentios, que não têm lei, fazem por natureza as coisas da lei, eles, embora não tendo lei, para si mesmos são lei.
verses.en_web: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
verses.en_bbe: For when the Gentiles without the law have a natural desire to do the things in the law, they are a law to themselves;

verses.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
verses.pt: pois mostram a obra da lei escrita em seus corações, testificando juntamente a sua consciência e os seus pensamentos, quer acusando-os, quer defendendo-os),
verses.en_web: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
verses.en_bbe: Because the work of the law is seen in their hearts, their sense of right and wrong giving witness to it, while their minds are at one time judging them and at another giving them approval;

verses.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
verses.pt: no dia em que Deus há de julgar os segredos dos homens, por Cristo Jesus, segundo o meu evangelho.
verses.en_web: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: In the day when God will be a judge of the secrets of men, as it says in the good news of which I am a preacher, through Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
verses.pt: Mas se tu és chamado judeu, e repousas na lei, e te glorias em Deus;
verses.en_web: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,
verses.en_bbe: But as for you who have the name of Jew, and are resting on the law, and take pride in God,

verses.en: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
verses.pt: e conheces a sua vontade e aprovas as coisas excelentes, sendo instruído na lei;
verses.en_web: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
verses.en_bbe: And have knowledge of his desires, and are a judge of the things which are different, having the learning of the law,

verses.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
verses.pt: e confias que és guia dos cegos, luz dos que estão em trevas,
verses.en_web: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
verses.en_bbe: In the belief that you are a guide to the blind, a light to those in the dark,

verses.en: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
verses.pt: instruidor dos néscios, mestre de crianças, que tens na lei a forma da ciência e da verdade;
verses.en_web: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
verses.en_bbe: A teacher of the foolish, having in the law the form of knowledge and of what is true;

verses.en: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.pt: tu, pois, que ensinas a outrem, não te ensinas a ti mesmo? Tu, que pregas que não se deve furtar, furtas?
verses.en_web: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
verses.en_bbe: You who give teaching to others, do you give it to yourself? you who say that a man may not take what is not his, do you take what is not yours?

verses.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.pt: Tu, que dizes que não se deve cometer adultério, adultéras? Tu, que abominas os ídolos, roubas os templos?
verses.en_web: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
verses.en_bbe: You who say that a man may not be untrue to his wife, are you true to yours? you who are a hater of images, do you do wrong to the house of God?

verses.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.pt: Tu, que te glorias na lei, desonras a Deus pela transgressão da lei?
verses.en_web: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
verses.en_bbe: You who take pride in the law, are you doing wrong to the honour of God by behaviour which is against the law?

verses.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.pt: Assim pois, por vossa causa, o nome de Deus é blasfemado entre os gentios, como está escrito.
verses.en_web: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
verses.en_bbe: For the name of God is shamed among the Gentiles because of you, as it is said in the holy Writings.

verses.en: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.pt: Porque a circuncisão é, na verdade, proveitosa, se guardares a lei; mas se tu és transgressor da lei, a tua circuncisão tem-se tornado em incircuncisão.
verses.en_web: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
verses.en_bbe: It is true that circumcision is of use if you keep the law, but if you go against the law it is as if you had it not.

verses.en: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.pt: Se, pois, a incircuncisão guardar os preceitos da lei, porventura a incircuncisão não será reputada como circuncisão?
verses.en_web: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
verses.en_bbe: If those who have not circumcision keep the rules of the law, will it not be credited to them as circumcision?

verses.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.pt: E a incircuncisão que por natureza o é, se cumpre a lei, julgará a ti, que com a letra e a circuncisão és transgressor da lei.
verses.en_web: Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
verses.en_bbe: And they, by their keeping of the law without circumcision, will be judges of you, by whom the law is broken though you have the letter of the law and circumcision.

verses.en: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.pt: Porque não é judeu o que o é exteriormente, nem é circuncisão a que o é exteriormente na carne.
verses.en_web: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
verses.en_bbe: The true Jew is not one who is only so publicly, and circumcision is not that which may be seen in the flesh:

verses.en: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
verses.pt: Mas é judeu aquele que o é interiormente, e circuncisão é a do coração, no espírito, e não na letra; cujo louvor não provém dos homens, mas de Deus.
verses.en_web: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
verses.en_bbe: But he is a Jew who is a secret one, whose circumcision is of the heart, in the spirit and not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
